title: Approval & Permissions
description: Tool calls pass through the approval_policy gate before the shell ever runs them.

steps.annotation: The user asks for a filesystem action that may be safe or dangerous depending on the path.

steps.content: I'll check the target before running the command.
steps.annotation: The model can propose a tool call, but the harness decides whether execution is allowed.
A destructive-looking command reaches the approval gate.

steps.content: approval_policy=on-request: command is not in the trusted allowlist -> escalate to the user
steps.annotation: Under on-request the harness asks before running anything it cannot verify as safe.
The runtime pauses before execution and resumes only after approval.
Approved commands continue through the normal tool result path.
